verdict.rationale: Ironclad has a dedicated 'Ironclad AI' product page referencing 'contract intelligence,' suggesting some built-in AI capability, but the evidence pack contains only marketing taglines with no detail on what tasks can be delegated to an assistant, how it's invoked, or its scope. Missing for 10: description of assistant task delegation, concrete feature list, hands-on or independent corroboration of AI assistant functionality.
